title: Unit Event — Parallel Harmonies — Episode8 Intersecting Harmonies

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need is finally going to start writing its debut song! However, Mr. Shindo has a request: that Saki and Ichika compose it together. The pair are determined to make it a great song, but things don't go so smoothly...

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We're gonna write the best song ever...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi said that she'd turn my feelings into music.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (To make sure Leo/need's debut single turns out amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And I don't want to let her down!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, I've come up with a rough melody!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll listen to it now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I like it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What you said was all there.
It let me know that everything is going to be okay, and how we can all move forward together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what's up?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What if you took this part of the chorus and added it to the beginning of the song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The melody for the chorus is really compelling, so I think it'd leave a nice impression if I sang right from the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This song's about telling the listener they'll be able to move forward despite whatever is bothering them, so I feel like that'd be a good way for this song to start off.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, you could gradually add more instruments to show the listener that they're not alone. That they'll be able to move forward together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like we did with our band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Thanks, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, we'll add the chorus to the beginning, and start with just us on keyboard and vocals...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, um... Are we increasing the tempo towards the end of the chorus?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! That'll make it feel like we're running towards our goal together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, once we have every instrument involved, we could throw in a break to signal the start of the next part. How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If we start playing again with just the right timing, it should provide the listener with a nice sense of togetherness.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I really like that idea...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, the following verse should try to maintain that momentum while telling the next part of the story.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How do you want to do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess this part will be about pain or doubt... But with the sense that you need to start moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we might want to keep it a bit subdued like it already is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. This verse really hits home when I think about everything we went through...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can almost feel this melody wrapping its arms around me when I look back on what happened...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. What if we placed more of an emphasis on moving forward one step at a time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One step at a time...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, we could throw in some triplets.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We could even have Shiho sing for this part, and Hona here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah! Then it'd feel like we're each taking the next step!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe! Alright, let's do that!
Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (This is the opposite of earlier. We can't stop coming up with good ideas now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Is this because Ichi decided to do what Miku and the others did? She really understands how I feel now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We can do it now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We have to succeed...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Ichi, Miku and everyone are giving me all the help they can!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I have to make this the best song ever!)
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's done...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It finally is...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Your message about moving forward despite any pain or doubt is so clear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which makes me really glad...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...! And I couldn't have done it without you, Ichi. Thanks for all your help!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I didn't do anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have Miku and the others to thank for this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Because Miku and MEIKO...
Everyone in SEKAI helped make this song a reality.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so cool.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We first started our band so that we could play Miku songs together, and we really owe her and the others a lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, on top of that, they helped us produce an amazing debut single...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which sorta means we never would've been able to get this far without our VIRTUAL SINGER friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree completely...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?! Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, you've been posting Miku versions of our songs online, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, I have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, can you post this one too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want lots and lots of people to hear it. Also, I wanna hear what it sounds like when Miku and the others sing it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They made this song possible, so I want to give it the respect it deserves!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's ask Mr. Shindo about this when we have him listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. However, there is a real possibility that we'll be told this song isn't good enough...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No way!
I mean, this is our best song yet♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho and Hona also need to listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make a song that properly reflects how we both feel someday, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We went with my feeling this time, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wanna make a song about the both of us someday. Even if we can't agree on everything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's pinky swear...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Someday, we're going to write a song about us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days later
Solis Records

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Interesting...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I was expecting you two to come up with a song where both of your styles and personalities would be there at the forefront...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: That being said, this is still a remarkable song.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Within this kindness... This empathy I'm feeling... There's a subtle but strangely powerful sound. It's like I'm being told that I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: You two did an excellent job making those work together. I take it you lead in writing it, Ms. Tenma, with Ms. Hoshino as more of an arranger...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-Yes, that's right... We actually tried to do what you said just now at first, Mr. Shindo, but we couldn't get our feelings to really mesh...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: No, I'm beyond impressed that you were able to come up with this in such a short amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Well done.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
It doesn't matter how things transpired.
You two worked hard to make this happen, and I believe this is a good representation of what Leo/need's music is going to sound like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
Yes, let's go with this song.
I'm sure Mr. Shimizu is also going to enjoy hearing this.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And above all else... I've got a feeling that this is going to hit home with a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear...!
Thank you both for all your hard work!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's pretty incredible how you were able to come up with something this good so fast.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I have Ichi and our “seniors” to thank.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku and the others gave us some advice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
Mr. Shindo, there's something we'd like to ask you...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We were hoping that we could make a VIRTUAL SINGER version of this song to post online...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's just... We think that it'll help give this song more reach!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Would that be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I see. A VIRTUAL SINGER version...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I like it. Why not...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Yes, as long as you post it after the official Leo/need version has been released. That way, people will know which is the original.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: It'll be a nice way to advertise your band.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: We can discuss when you'll be able to post it at a later date.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I want lots and lots of people to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: They will. Very soon.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: However, you'll need to actually record it first. I'll be there for that, so let's all do our best to do this song justice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Record it...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-It really feels like we're pros now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
You'll get used to it in no time.
Things will go smoothly as long as you relax and play the way you normally do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He just told you to relax.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But still... I don't blame you for feeling nervous or anxious. After all, this song means a lot to the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, it is an amazing song...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, thank you both...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to playing it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too...!
se_event_parallel_2024_001
Two months later

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Seriously, how are they running this late?
I'm so bored...

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: Huh? Whose song is this?

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: I kinda like it...
se_event_parallel_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler
rows.Line: Hey, did you get a chance to listen to that song?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler
rows.Line: Yeah, it's really good. I feel so encouraged by it...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler
rows.Line: They even made a VIRTUAL SINGER version, which is also really amazing...
se_event_parallel_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Male High Schooler
rows.Line: You've been listening to that song basically on loop lately.

rows.Speaker: Male High Schooler
rows.Line: Yeah, I find it really soothing for some reason. It helps put my mind at ease, and gives me a nice boost of energy.

rows.Speaker: Male High Schooler
rows.Line:
You should give it a listen.
I'll send you the link now.
